output.summary_en: The forwarded Indonesian message claims that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips designed to track vaccinated individuals. It urges recipients to share the warning across all groups before it gets deleted.

claims.claim_original: Vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip untuk melacak setiap orang yang sudah divaksin.
claims.claim_en: COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track vaccinated individuals.
search_queries_en: COVID-19 vaccine microchip tracking fact check
